title: Listening radio with grass
summary: Two experimenters hold blades of grass near a radio transmitter antenna and hear the AM station through the arc between antenna and grass. It is a short, informal demonstration of unintentional AM demodulation.
why: HN commenters bring it out whenever AM radio, strong transmitters or accidental demodulation comes up, as the classic example of grass playing radio.

quote.text: AM radio is such a simple modulation scheme that even a piece of grass can be used to demodulate it, with enough power.
